crime: Earlier that week in the library, the girl added a new invented island to a handmade atlas for {WITCH_NAME}. Today, she erased the invented islands, returned the atlas to her, and refused to keep making it together.

During free time, a prisoner saw the two swimming together in the lake. After that refusal, {WITCH_NAME} encircled the girl with both arms and leaned backward beneath the surface. She used her Magic to become stone, anchoring them underwater. Once the girl had drowned, {WITCH_NAME} returned to flesh; her restored hands opened and released the body. She emerged from the lake alone.

A prisoner later recovered the girl's body. The sighting of the two together and {WITCH_NAME}'s solitary return made the drowning look like a swimming accident. But an examination of the girl's upper arms found bruises from a grip that had encircled them. Those marks overturned the apparent accident: the girl had been held in an embrace and forced beneath the water by the swimmer who came back without her.
fields.epitaph: She answered one refusal by making every reply after it impossible.
execution: The execution stand holds her with her back against the palm of a giant articulated hand. Its jointed fingers fold over her torso and tighten into a crushing embrace. The grip holds until all movement stops. Then the hand opens, leaving her body motionless on its palm.

magic.name: Living Stone
magic.text: Turn yourself into a conscious, indestructible statue of stone.
